column4: Same camera and scale as the reference pose. The lifted foot has now come down one stride ahead and touched the ground, both feet planted, body leaning a little forward, arms loose. Three-quarter front view. Full-body view of the same porcelain maid doll as in the reference sheet and the approved pose: same face, long orange hair, orange flower ornament with white center, black dress with white apron and ruffles, white boots, ball joints and wrist rings. Exactly two arms, two legs, two feet and five fingers per hand; no strings, no controller, no floor, no shadow. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it. The whole figure fits the frame with a small margin.

Close-up, looking up from below at the puppeteer's white-gloved wrist and ruffled cuff in the orange sleeve, same hand style and coal background as the reference. Around the wrist a thin tan-gold (#A68957) string is tied in a small loop, and from the knot a single taut string climbs straight upward and out of the top of the frame. The hand hangs limply at the lower part of the frame, fingers loose. No controller bars, no text.

Identical locked camera, nave and stage as the references. The floor hatch in the front of the stage is HALF open: two hinged boards have lifted only about a quarter turn, a narrow dark slot showing between them with just a hint of book spines inside. No figures.
